info.name: matchmaking
info.description:
Complete matchmaking backend API — auth-service + matchmaking-api.

## Services
- **auth-service** (:8081) — session JWT issuance + JWKS
- **matchmaking-api** (:8080) — HTTP/WebSocket gateway (tickets, history, WS push)

## Start (order matters)
```bash
mvn -B install -DskipTests   # build + install every module FIRST
mvn -pl services/auth-service exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=com.victor.matchmaking.auth.AuthServiceApplication
mvn -pl services/matchmaking-api exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=com.victor.matchmaking.api.MatchmakingApiApplication
mvn -pl services/matchmaking-engine exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=com.victor.matchmaking.engine.MatchmakingEngineApplication
```

## Auth
Every matchmaking-api request except `/health` needs a Bearer token from `POST /v1/auth/login`.

## WebSocket
Open `WS Connect`, then send frames: PING, MATCH_CONFIRM, MATCH_DECLINE. Incoming: PONG, MATCH_PENDING_CONFIRMATION, MATCH_CONFIRMED, MATCH_CANCELLED, ERROR.

item.name: POST /v1/auth/login
item.description:
Issue a session token. In dev, login auto-provisions the player.

**Expected:** 200 with `{ "token": "...", "expiresIn": 3600 }`.
**Error:** missing/blank playerId → 400.

item.name: GET /.well-known/jwks.json
item.description:
Public keys for offline JWT validation. matchmaking-api fetches this on startup.

**Expected:** 200 with `{ "keys": [ { "kty": "RSA", "alg": "RS256", "kid": ... } ] }`.

item.name: GET /health
item.description:
Liveness probe (no auth).

**Expected:** 200 with `{ "status": "UP" }`.

item.name: POST /v1/matchmaking/tickets
item.description:
Enqueue a player for matchmaking.

**Expected:** 201 with `{ "ticketId", "status": "SEARCHING", ... }`.
**Idempotency:** same `Idempotency-Key` returns the same ticket.
**Errors:** invalid payload → 400; missing token → 401.

item.name: POST /v1/matchmaking/tickets — idempotent replay
item.description: Same `Idempotency-Key` returns the SAME ticketId (idempotent).

item.name: POST /v1/matchmaking/tickets — invalid payload (400)
item.description: Missing fields → expect 400.

item.name: POST /v1/matchmaking/tickets — no token (401)
item.description: No token → expect 401.

item.name: GET /v1/matchmaking/tickets/{ticketId}
item.description:
Fetch ticket status.

**Expected:** 200 with the ticket JSON.
**Errors:** unknown id → 404; other player's ticket → 403.

item.name: GET /v1/matchmaking/tickets/{ticketId} — unknown id (404)
item.description: Unknown id → expect 404.

item.name: DELETE /v1/matchmaking/tickets/{ticketId}
item.description:
Cancel a search. Only while SEARCHING and owned by the authenticated player.

**Expected:** 200 (status: CANCELLED).
**Errors:** unknown id → 404; other player → 403; not SEARCHING → 409.

item.name: DELETE /v1/matchmaking/tickets/{ticketId} — second cancel (409)
item.description: Second cancel → expect 409 (already CANCELLED).

item.name: DELETE /v1/matchmaking/tickets/{ticketId} — unknown id (404)
item.description: Unknown id → expect 404.

item.name: POST /v1/matchmaking/tickets — party enqueue
item.description:
Enqueue every member of a party in one atomic request.

**Expected:** 201; every member of the party is queued together.
**Errors:** unknown party → 400; missing token → 401.

item.name: GET /v1/parties/{partyId}
item.description:
Fetch a party with its aggregated skill and dispersion.

**Expected:** 200 with the party JSON.
**Errors:** unknown party → 404.

item.name: POST /v1/parties
item.description:
Create a party owned by the authenticated leader.

**Expected:** 201 with `{ "partyId" }` — the party id is stored in the `partyId` environment variable.
**Errors:** missing token → 401; blank leaderId is not applicable (the leader is the caller).

item.name: POST /v1/parties/{partyId}/members
item.description:
Add the authenticated player to a party.

**Expected:** 200 with the updated party.
**Errors:** party not found → 404; not a member → 403; party dissolved → 409.

item.name: DELETE /v1/parties/{partyId}/members/{playerId}
item.description:
Remove a member. Only the party leader may remove another member.

**Expected:** 200 with the updated party, or 403 for a non-leader.
**Errors:** player not a member → 403.

item.name: DELETE /v1/parties/{partyId}
item.description:
Dissolve a party. Only the party leader may dissolve it.

**Expected:** 200 with the dissolved party, or 403 for a non-leader.
**Errors:** unknown party → 404.

item.name: GET /v1/players/{playerId}/matches
item.description:
Cursor-paginated match history (newest first).

**Expected:** 200 with `{ "items": [...], "nextCursor": "..." | null }`.
**Errors:** limit out of range → 400; invalid cursor → 400; other player → 403.

item.name: GET /v1/players/{playerId}/matches — other player (403)
item.description: Another player's history → expect 403.

item.name: GET /v1/players/{playerId}/matches — limit out of range (400)
item.description: Limit out of range → expect 400.

item.name: GET /v1/players/{playerId}/matches — invalid cursor (400)
item.description: Invalid cursor → expect 400.

item.name: WS Connect
item.description:
Push notifications channel. Open the connection, then send frames.

**Client→server:**
- `{"type":"PING","payload":{}}` → expect `PONG`
- `{"type":"MATCH_CONFIRM","payload":{"matchId":"..."}}` → confirm
- `{"type":"MATCH_DECLINE","payload":{"matchId":"..."}}` → decline

**Server→client:** `PONG`, `MATCH_PENDING_CONFIRMATION`, `MATCH_CONFIRMED`, `MATCH_CANCELLED`, `ERROR`.

The matchmaking-engine must be running for pairing/confirmation.

item.description: Open WebSocket for p1. Send PING to test. Expect PONG.

item.name: 4. WS Connect p2
item.description: Open WebSocket for p2. Send PING to test. Expect PONG.
